name: [UPD]Don't Wake The Baddies!
desc:
Promo Codes in community server!!

Welcome to Don't Wake the Baddies!
Shh... Don't wake the Baddie 🤫

Sneak around and steal Baddies while they sleep! 😴
Escape when you wake them up and they start chasing! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many Baddies as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍

Made by Empowered Games 🚀
